title: fix: resolve TS2742 in drawer.tsx and sidebar.tsx for portable declaration files
body:
pnpm strict module resolution prevents TypeScript from portably naming types from transitive dependencies (`vaul` → `@radix-ui/react-dialog`). The vite-dts plugin silently skipped `drawer.d.ts` and `sidebar.d.ts`, causing all downstream consumers (plugin-view, apps/console, apps/site) to fail with `Module '"@object-ui/components"' has no exported member 'Drawer'`.

Replace `typeof DrawerPrimitive.X` / `typeof Separator` references with concrete HTML element types in `forwardRef` generics so declarations don't reference non-portable pnpm store paths:

```tsx
// Before — TS2742: cannot be named without a reference to @radix-ui/react-dialog
const DrawerContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DrawerPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DrawerPrimitive.Content>
>(...)

// After — portable, concrete types
const DrawerContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<"div">
>(...)
```

- **`drawer.tsx`** — `DrawerTrigger`, `DrawerClose` get explicit `React.FC` annotations with `asChild`; `DrawerOverlay`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerTitle`, `DrawerDescription` use concrete HTML element types
- **`sidebar.tsx`** — `SidebarSeparator` uses `HTMLDivElement` + inline `orientation`/`decorative` props instead of `typeof Separator`
